brief.zh: 这回的分类器是 ViT：类别 token 拿它的查询 q 去问照片的每一个 4×4 图块。第三个输入在车所在的图块上是 1。输出一个数：类别 token 的注意力有多大比例落在车上。
brief.en: This time the classifier is a ViT: the class token asks every 4×4 patch of the photo with its query q. The third input is 1 on the patches with the car. Output one number: what fraction of the class token's attention falls on the car.

hint.zh: Q、K 决定看谁，V 决定看完带回什么。要是带回的就是「这块是不是车」呢？
hint.en: Q and K decide whom to look at; V decides what comes back. What if what comes back is "is this patch the car"?

after.zh: V 换成掩膜，注意力加权平均出来的就是落在车上的权重之和。真的 ViT 有十几层、每层好几个头，要把各层的注意力连乘起来（attention rollout）或者看对分类贡献大的头；只看一个头，很容易被骗。
after.en: With the mask as V, the weighted average attention gives is the total weight on the car. A real ViT has a dozen layers of several heads each, so the attention of every layer is multiplied through (attention rollout), or only the heads that matter for the class are read; one head alone is easy to be fooled by.

t.zh: ViT 不是每格一个权重：它把照片切成图块，最前面多放一个类别 token，分类只读它的输出。类别 token 拿自己的查询去问每一个图块，按回答分配注意力。
t.en: A ViT has no weight per cell: it cuts the photo into patches and puts an extra class token in front, and only that token's output is read to classify. The class token asks every patch with its own query and shares out its attention by the answers.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="attention"></part-ref>又回来了。这一关的掩膜按 4×4 图块画：车所在的图块是 1。你要做的：输出类别 token 的注意力有多大比例落在车上。
t.en: The <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref> is back in the tray. This level's mask is drawn by 4×4 patch: 1 on the patches with the car. Your task: output what fraction of the class token's attention falls on the car.

label.en: Asking "bright on the left, dark on the right?"
